# 3. Read Data

```{r read-data}
# Morphological matrix
morpho      <- read.nexus.data("/Users/Flo/Downloads/Boxfish/morpho/Ostracioidea_K95_WT83.nex")
morpho_mat  <- do.call(rbind, morpho)
cat("Morpho taxa:", nrow(morpho_mat), "\n")
cat("Morpho characters:", ncol(morpho_mat), "\n")
cat("Morpho taxa names:\n"); print(rownames(morpho_mat))

# Mitogenome alignment
mol <- read.dna("/Users/Flo/Downloads/Boxfish/boxfish-seqs/mitogenomes/all_mitogenomes_aligned.fasta",
                format = "fasta")
rownames(mol) <- gsub(" .*", "", rownames(mol))
cat("\nMolecular taxa:", nrow(mol), "\n")
cat("Molecular characters:", ncol(mol), "\n")
cat("Molecular taxa names:\n"); print(rownames(mol))

# FToL alignment (Ostraciidae + Triodon)
ostrax <- read.dna("~/Downloads/Boxfish/ftol/Ostraciidae.phylip", 
                   format = "sequential")
cat("\nFToL taxa:", nrow(ostrax), "\n")
cat("FToL characters:", ncol(ostrax), "\n")
cat("FToL taxa names:\n"); print(rownames(ostrax))

# Check FToL download date
cat("\nFToL file date:", 
    format(file.info("~/Downloads/Boxfish/final_alignment.phylip")$mtime), "\n")
```

# 4. FToL Alignment: Add Triodon Outgroup

```{r ftol-triodon}
# Extract Triodon from the full FToL alignment
# Run once, then comment out the read line and load from cache instead

ftol_cache <- "~/Downloads/Boxfish/cache/ftol_full.rds"

if(!file.exists(ftol_cache)) {
  dir.create("~/Downloads/Boxfish/cache", showWarnings=FALSE)
  ftol_full <- read.dna("~/Downloads/Boxfish/final_alignment.phylip", 
                        format="interleaved")
  saveRDS(ftol_full, ftol_cache)
  cat("Saved ftol_full to cache\n")
} else {
  ftol_full <- readRDS(ftol_cache)
  cat("Loaded ftol_full from cache\n")
}

cat("Dimensions:", nrow(ftol_full), "taxa x", ncol(ftol_full), "chars\n")

triodon <- ftol_full[grep("Triodon_macropterus", rownames(ftol_full)), ]

# Combine with Ostraciidae
combined_ftol <- rbind(ostrax, triodon)
cat("Combined FToL taxa:", nrow(combined_ftol), "\n")
cat("Characters:", ncol(combined_ftol), "\n")

# Write as sequential phylip for IQ-TREE
write.dna(combined_ftol,
          file = "~/Downloads/Boxfish/ftol/Ostraciidae_with_triodon.phylip",
          format = "sequential",
          colsep = "",
          nbcol  = -1)

# Verify
test <- read.dna("~/Downloads/Boxfish/ftol/Ostraciidae_with_triodon.phylip", 
                 format = "sequential")
cat("Verified taxa:", nrow(test), "| Characters:", ncol(test), "\n")
cat("Triodon name:", rownames(test)[grep("Triodon", rownames(test))], "\n")
```

# 6. LASTZ Synteny Plot

```{r lastz-synteny}
parse_maf <- function(filepath) {
  lines   <- readLines(filepath)
  s_lines <- lines[grepl("^s ", lines)]
  lapply(s_lines, function(l) {
    parts <- strsplit(trimws(l), "\\s+")[[1]]
    list(src=parts[2], start=as.numeric(parts[3]),
         size=as.numeric(parts[4]), strand=parts[5],
         srcSize=as.numeric(parts[6]))
  })
}

maf_dir   <- "~/Downloads/Boxfish/lastz_out/"
maf_files <- list.files(maf_dir, pattern="\\.maf$", full.names=TRUE)

all_blocks <- map_dfr(maf_files, function(f) {
  species <- gsub("_vs_ref.maf", "", basename(f))
  species <- gsub("_mitogenome.*", "", species)
  species <- gsub("_", " ", species)
  blocks  <- parse_maf(f)
  if(length(blocks) < 2) return(NULL)
  ref_block   <- blocks[[1]]
  query_block <- blocks[[2]]
  data.frame(
    species     = species,
    ref_start   = ref_block$start,
    ref_end     = ref_block$start + ref_block$size,
    query_start = query_block$start,
    query_end   = query_block$start + query_block$size,
    query_size  = query_block$srcSize
  )
})

ggplot(all_blocks, aes(x=ref_start, xend=ref_end, y=species, yend=species)) +
  geom_segment(linewidth=8, aes(color=species)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(0, 16829), linetype="dashed", alpha=0.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels=scales::comma,
                     name="Reference position (bp)",
                     limits=c(0, 17500)) +
  labs(title="Mitogenome synteny vs. Ostracion immaculatus reference", y="") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position="none",
        axis.text.y=element_text(face="italic", size=9))
```

# 7. Build Total Evidence Nexus

```{r total-evidence-matrix}
n_mol_chars   <- ncol(mol)
n_morpho_chars <- ncol(morpho_mat)
all_taxa      <- name_map_df$morpho_code

# Molecular matrix — fill with ? then insert real data
mol_combined <- matrix("?", nrow=nrow(name_map_df), ncol=n_mol_chars,
                       dimnames=list(all_taxa, NULL))
for(i in seq_len(nrow(name_map_df))) {
  acc <- name_map_df$accession[i]
  if(!is.na(acc) && acc %in% rownames(mol))
    mol_combined[i, ] <- as.character(mol[acc, ])
}

# Morpho matrix — fill with ? then insert real data
morpho_combined <- matrix("?", nrow=nrow(name_map_df), ncol=n_morpho_chars,
                          dimnames=list(all_taxa, NULL))
for(i in seq_len(nrow(name_map_df))) {
  code <- name_map_df$morpho_code[i]
  if(code %in% names(morpho))
    morpho_combined[i, ] <- morpho[[code]]
}

n_mol   <- ncol(mol_combined)
n_morph <- ncol(morpho_combined)
n_total <- n_mol + n_morph
taxa_names <- rownames(mol_combined)

cat("Combined matrix:", length(taxa_names), "taxa x", n_total, "characters\n")
cat("Molecular: 1 -", n_mol, "\n")
cat("Morpho:", n_mol+1, "-", n_total, "\n")

# Write nexus
triodon_name <- taxa_names[grep("riodon", taxa_names, ignore.case=TRUE)]
con <- file("/Users/Flo/Downloads/Boxfish/boxfish-seqs/mitogenomes/total_evidence.nex", "w")
writeLines("#NEXUS", con)
writeLines("", con)
writeLines("begin data;", con)
writeLines(paste0("  dimensions ntax=", length(taxa_names), " nchar=", n_total, ";"), con)
writeLines("  format datatype=mixed(dna:1-21326, standard:21327-21446) interleave=no missing=? gap=-;", con)
writeLines("  matrix", con)
for(i in seq_along(taxa_names)) {
  writeLines(paste0("  ", taxa_names[i], "  ",
                    paste(mol_combined[i,], collapse=""),
                    paste(morpho_combined[i,], collapse="")), con)
}
writeLines("  ;", con)
writeLines("end;", con)
writeLines("", con)
writeLines("begin mrbayes;", con)
writeLines("  set autoclose=yes nowarn=yes;", con)
writeLines("", con)
writeLines(paste0("  charset molecular = 1-", n_mol, ";"), con)
writeLines(paste0("  charset morpho = ", n_mol+1, "-", n_total, ";"), con)
writeLines("  partition totalevidence = 2: molecular, morpho;", con)
writeLines("  set partition = totalevidence;", con)
writeLines("", con)
writeLines("  lset applyto=(1) nst=6 rates=gamma ngammacat=4;", con)
writeLines("  lset applyto=(2) nst=1 rates=gamma ngammacat=4 coding=variable;", con)
writeLines("", con)
writeLines("  prset applyto=(1) statefreqpr=dirichlet(1,1,1,1);", con)
writeLines("  prset applyto=(2) symdirihyperpr=fixed(infinity);", con)
writeLines("  prset applyto=(all) ratepr=variable;", con)
writeLines("", con)
writeLines("  unlink statefreq=(all) revmat=(all) shape=(all);", con)
writeLines("", con)
writeLines(paste0("  outgroup ", triodon_name, ";"), con)
writeLines("  mcmc ngen=2000000 nchains=4 nruns=2", con)
writeLines("       samplefreq=500 printfreq=500", con)
writeLines("       savebrlens=yes filename=boxfish_total;", con)
writeLines("  sump burnin=500;", con)
writeLines("  sumt burnin=500;", con)
writeLines("end;", con)
close(con)

# Verify
lines <- readLines("/Users/Flo/Downloads/Boxfish/boxfish-seqs/mitogenomes/total_evidence.nex")
cat("\nTotal lines:", length(lines), "\n")
cat("Last 10 lines:\n")
cat(tail(lines, 10), sep="\n")
```

# 8. Data Coverage Heatmap

```{r coverage-heatmap}
mito_species  <- names(name_map)                         # accession IDs — convert
mito_sp_latin <- unname(name_map)                        # Latin names
ftol_species  <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(ostrax))
morpho_species <- names(morpho)

# Any extras in datasets not in target list
extras <- setdiff(unique(c(mito_sp_latin, ftol_species, morpho_species)),
                  target_species)
if(length(extras) > 0) cat("Extra species not in target list:\n", 
                            paste(extras, collapse="\n"), "\n")

all_species <- sort(unique(c(target_species, extras)))

ftol_mito_loci    <- c("COI","cytb","16S","12S","ND2","ND4")
ftol_nuclear_loci <- c("4c4","enc1","ficd","glyt","hoxc6a","kiaa1239","myh6",
                       "panx2","plagl2","ptr","rag1","rag2","rhodopsin","ripk4",
                       "sh3px3","sidkey","sreb2","svep1","tbr1","vcpip","zic1")

coverage <- data.frame(
  Species        = all_species,
  Mitogenome     = all_species %in% mito_sp_latin,
  Mito_loci_FToL = all_species %in% ftol_species,
  Nuclear_loci   = all_species %in% ftol_species,
  Morphology     = all_species %in% gsub("_", " ", names(morpho_map))
)

coverage_long <- coverage %>%
  pivot_longer(-Species, names_to="Data_type", values_to="Present") %>%
  mutate(
    Data_type = factor(Data_type,
                       levels=c("Mitogenome","Mito_loci_FToL",
                                "Nuclear_loci","Morphology")),
    Species = factor(Species, levels=rev(all_species))
  )

ggplot(coverage_long, aes(x=Data_type, y=Species, fill=Present)) +
  geom_tile(color="white", linewidth=0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("TRUE"="#2d6a4f", "FALSE"="#f0f0f0"),
                    labels=c("TRUE"="Present", "FALSE"="Absent")) +
  labs(title="Data coverage across taxa", x="", y="", fill="") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
        axis.text.y=element_text(face="italic", size=8))
```

# 9. NCBI Availability Search (rentrez)

```{r ncbi-search, cache=TRUE}
locus_terms <- list(
  # Mitochondrial
  "COI"       = "COI[ALL] OR COX1[ALL] OR cytochrome oxidase subunit 1[ALL]",
  "cytb"      = "cytochrome b[ALL]",
  "16S"       = "16S[ALL] OR 16S ribosomal[ALL]",
  "12S"       = "12S[ALL] OR 12S ribosomal[ALL]",
  "ND2"       = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 2[ALL] OR ND2[ALL]",
  "ND4"       = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 4[ALL] OR ND4[ALL]",
  "ND1"       = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 1[ALL] OR ND1[ALL]",
  "ND3"       = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 3[ALL] OR ND3[ALL]",
  "ND4L"      = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 4L[ALL] OR ND4L[ALL]",
  "ND5"       = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 5[ALL] OR ND5[ALL]",
  "ND6"       = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 6[ALL] OR ND6[ALL]",
  "COX2"      = "COX2[ALL] OR cytochrome oxidase subunit 2[ALL]",
  "COX3"      = "COX3[ALL] OR cytochrome oxidase subunit 3[ALL]",
  "ATP6"      = "ATP6[ALL] OR ATPase subunit 6[ALL]",
  "ATP8"      = "ATP8[ALL] OR ATPase subunit 8[ALL]",
  # Nuclear
  "4c4"       = "4c4[ALL]",
  "enc1"      = "enc1[ALL] OR ectodermal-neural cortex[ALL]",
  "ficd"      = "ficd[ALL]",
  "glyt"      = "glyt[ALL] OR glycine transporter[ALL]",
  "hoxc6a"    = "hoxc6a[ALL] OR hoxc6[ALL]",
  "kiaa1239"  = "kiaa1239[ALL]",
  "myh6"      = "myh6[ALL] OR myosin heavy chain 6[ALL]",
  "panx2"     = "panx2[ALL] OR pannexin 2[ALL]",
  "plagl2"    = "plagl2[ALL]",
  "ptr"       = "ptr[ALL] OR parathyroid hormone receptor[ALL]",
  "rag1"      = "rag1[ALL] OR recombination activating gene 1[ALL]",
  "rag2"      = "rag2[ALL] OR recombination activating gene 2[ALL]",
  "rhodopsin" = "rhodopsin[ALL]",
  "ripk4"     = "ripk4[ALL]",
  "sh3px3"    = "sh3px3[ALL]",
  "sidkey"    = "sidkey[ALL]",
  "sreb2"     = "sreb2[ALL]",
  "svep1"     = "svep1[ALL]",
  "tbr1"      = "tbr1[ALL] OR T-box brain transcription factor[ALL]",
  "vcpip"     = "vcpip[ALL]",
  "zic1"      = "zic1[ALL] OR zinc finger protein ZIC1[ALL]"
)

results_list <- list()
total   <- length(target_species) * length(locus_terms)
counter <- 0

for(sp in target_species) {
  for(locus in names(locus_terms)) {
    counter <- counter + 1
    cat(sprintf("[%d/%d] %s - %s\n", counter, total, sp, locus))

    query <- paste0('"', sp, '"[ORGN] AND (', locus_terms[[locus]],
                    ') AND 200:20000[SLEN]')

    res <- tryCatch(
      entrez_search(db="nucleotide", term=query, retmax=10),
      error=function(e) NULL
    )
    Sys.sleep(0.34)

    if(is.null(res) || res$count == 0) {
      results_list[[paste(sp, locus)]] <- data.frame(
        species=sp, locus=locus, accession=NA, length=NA, found=FALSE)
      next
    }

    summ <- tryCatch(
      entrez_summary(db="nucleotide", id=res$ids),
      error=function(e) NULL
    )
    if(is.null(summ)) {
      results_list[[paste(sp, locus)]] <- data.frame(
        species=sp, locus=locus, accession=NA, length=NA, found=FALSE)
      next
    }

    if(length(res$ids) == 1) {
      best_id  <- res$ids[1]
      best_len <- summ$slen
    } else {
      lengths  <- sapply(summ, function(x) x$slen)
      best_idx <- which.max(lengths)
      best_id  <- res$ids[best_idx]
      best_len <- lengths[best_idx]
    }

    results_list[[paste(sp, locus)]] <- data.frame(
      species=sp, locus=locus,
      accession=best_id, length=best_len,
      found=TRUE)
  }
}

coverage_ncbi <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
write.csv(coverage_ncbi, "~/Downloads/Boxfish/ncbi_coverage.csv", row.names=FALSE)
dir.create("~/Downloads/Boxfish/cache", showWarnings=FALSE)
saveRDS(results_list, "~/Downloads/Boxfish/cache/ncbi_results.rds")
cat("Saved! File size:", round(file.size("~/Downloads/Boxfish/cache/ncbi_results.rds")/1e6, 1), "MB\n")
# Check it loads correctly
test <- readRDS("~/Downloads/Boxfish/cache/ncbi_results.rds")
cat("Entries:", length(test), "\n")
cat("Expected:", length(target_species) * length(locus_terms), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. EXTRACT LOCI FROM MITOGENOMES VIA LASTZ
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Output: loci/mito_extracted/
# Skipped if files already exist

rev_comp <- function(seq) {
  paste(rev(strsplit(chartr("ACGTacgt", "TGCAtgca", seq), "")[[1]]), collapse = "")
}

parse_maf <- function(filepath) {
  lines   <- readLines(filepath)
  a_lines <- which(startsWith(lines, "a "))
  blocks  <- lapply(a_lines, function(i) {
    s_idx <- which(startsWith(lines[(i+1):min(i+10, length(lines))], "s ")) + i
    if (length(s_idx) < 2) return(NULL)
    parse_s <- function(l) {
      p2 <- strsplit(trimws(l), "\\s+")[[1]]
      list(start = as.integer(p2[3]), size = as.integer(p2[4]),
           strand = p2[5], seq = p2[7])
    }
    list(ref = parse_s(lines[s_idx[1]]), query = parse_s(lines[s_idx[2]]))
  })
  Filter(Negate(is.null), blocks)
}

extract_locus_from_maf <- function(blocks, locus_start, locus_end, strand) {
  collected <- c()
  for (b in blocks) {
    r           <- b$ref
    blk_start_1 <- r$start + 1
    blk_end_1   <- r$start + r$size
    if (blk_end_1 < locus_start || blk_start_1 > locus_end) next
    ov_start  <- max(locus_start, blk_start_1)
    ov_end    <- min(locus_end,   blk_end_1)
    ref_chars <- strsplit(r$seq, "")[[1]]
    qry_chars <- strsplit(b$query$seq, "")[[1]]
    ref_pos   <- blk_start_1 - 1
    for (col in seq_along(ref_chars)) {
      if (ref_chars[col] != "-") {
        ref_pos <- ref_pos + 1
        if (ref_pos >= ov_start && ref_pos <= ov_end) {
          if (qry_chars[col] != "-") collected <- c(collected, qry_chars[col])
        }
        if (ref_pos > ov_end) break
      }
    }
  }
  if (length(collected) == 0) return(NULL)
  seq_out <- paste(collected, collapse = "")
  if (strand == "-") seq_out <- rev_comp(seq_out)
  seq_out
}

# Gene coordinates from NC_009865.1 (O. immaculatus reference)
ref_coords <- data.frame(
  locus  = c("12S","16S","ND1","ND2","COI","COX2","ATP8","ATP6",
             "COX3","ND3","ND4L","ND4","ND5","ND6","cytb"),
  start  = c(69,   1090, 2854, 4043, 5480, 7185, 7952, 8110,
             8793, 9650, 10069,10359,11954,13789,14385),
  end    = c(1017, 2781, 3828, 5088, 7030, 7875, 8119, 8792,
             9577, 9998, 10365,11739,13792,14310,15525),
  strand = c("+","+","+","+","+","+","+","+",
             "+","+","+","+","+","-","+"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (!file.exists(p("loci/mito_extracted/coi_mito.fa"))) {

  dir.create(p("loci/mito_extracted"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  maf_files <- list.files(p("lastz_out"), pattern = "\\.maf$", full.names = TRUE)

  for (loc in ref_coords$locus) {
    coords    <- ref_coords[ref_coords$locus == loc, ]
    out_lines <- c()

    for (maf_file in maf_files) {
      if (grepl("NC_009865", maf_file)) next  # skip ref vs ref

      acc <- gsub(".*_([A-Z][A-Z0-9_.]+)\\.maf$", "\\1", basename(maf_file))
      sp  <- taxonomy$species_full[
        !is.na(taxonomy$mitogenome_accession) &
          grepl(acc, taxonomy$mitogenome_accession, fixed = TRUE)]
      if (length(sp) == 0) next
      sp <- canonicalize(sp[1])

      blocks  <- parse_maf(maf_file)
      if (length(blocks) == 0) next

      seq_out <- extract_locus_from_maf(blocks, coords$start,
                                         coords$end, coords$strand)
      if (is.null(seq_out) || nchar(seq_out) == 0) next

      out_lines <- c(out_lines,
                     paste0(">", gsub(" ", "_", sp),
                            " [source=Mitogenome]",
                            " [accession=", acc, "]",
                            " [len=", nchar(seq_out), "]"),
                     seq_out)
    }

    if (length(out_lines) > 0) {
      writeLines(out_lines,
                 p("loci/mito_extracted", paste0(tolower(loc), "_mito.fa")))
      cat(sprintf("%-8s %d sequences extracted\n",
                  loc, sum(startsWith(out_lines, ">"))))
    }
  }
  cat("Done. Extracted loci in loci/mito_extracted/\n")
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. MERGE PER-LOCUS FASTAS: MITO EXTRACTED + FTOL + NCBI
# Priority: Mitogenome > longest of FToL or NCBI (filtering NCBI >10kb)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Canonical taxon set — 30 taxa
canonical_taxa <- c(
  "Anoplocapros amygdaloides", "Anoplocapros lenticularis", "Anoplocapros inermis",
  "Aracana aurita", "Aracana ornata", "Capropygia unistriata",
  "Kentrocapros aculeatus",
  "Acanthostracion guineensis", "Acanthostracion notacanthus",
  "Acanthostracion polygonius", "Acanthostracion quadricornis",
  "Lactophrys bicaudalis", "Lactophrys trigonus", "Lactophrys triqueter",
  "Lactoria cornuta", "Lactoria diaphana", "Lactoria fornasini",
  "Ostracion cubicus", "Ostracion cyanurus",
  "Ostracion immaculatus", "Ostracion meleagris", "Ostracion nasus",
  "Rhynchostracion rhinorhynchus", "Ostracion solorensis", "Ostracion whitleyi",
  "Tetrosomus concatenatus", "Tetrosomus gibbosus", "Ostracion reipublicae",
  "Polyplacapros tyleri",
  "Triodon macropterus"
)

read_fasta_list <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(list())
  lines <- readLines(path)
  idx   <- which(startsWith(lines, ">"))
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(list())
  mapply(function(s, e) paste(gsub("-", "", lines[s:e]), collapse = ""),
         idx + 1, c(idx[-1] - 1, length(lines)),
         SIMPLIFY = FALSE) |>
    setNames(sub("^>", "", lines[idx]))
}

parse_header_accession <- function(header) {
  m <- regmatches(header, regexpr("(?<=\\[accession=)[^\\]]+", header, perl = TRUE))
  if (length(m) == 0) return(NA)
  m
}

ncbi_acc <- coverage_ncbi |>
  filter(found == TRUE) |>
  mutate(species = canonicalize(species)) |>
  select(species, locus, accession)

ftol_acc <- taxonomy |>
  filter(!is.na(ftol_name)) |>
  select(species_full, ftol_name) |>
  deframe()

dir.create(p("loci/merged/mito"),    recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(p("loci/merged/nuclear"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (loc in all_loci) {

  is_mito   <- loc %in% mito_loci_names
  subdir    <- if (is_mito) p("loci/merged/mito") else p("loci/merged/nuclear")
  loc_lower <- tolower(loc)

  # 1. Mitogenome extracted
  mito_ext_seqs <- list()
  mito_ext_acc  <- list()
  if (is_mito) {
    mito_ext_path <- p("loci/mito_extracted", paste0(loc_lower, "_mito.fa"))
    if (file.exists(mito_ext_path)) {
      raw_lines <- readLines(mito_ext_path)
      idx <- which(startsWith(raw_lines, ">"))
      for (i in seq_along(idx)) {
        header  <- sub("^>", "", raw_lines[idx[i]])
        seq_end <- if (i < length(idx)) idx[i+1] - 1 else length(raw_lines)
        seq     <- paste(raw_lines[(idx[i]+1):seq_end], collapse = "")
        sp_can  <- canonicalize(sub(" \\[.*", "", header))
        mito_ext_seqs[[sp_can]] <- seq
        mito_ext_acc[[sp_can]]  <- parse_header_accession(header)
      }
    }
  }

  # 2. FToL (gap-stripped)
  ftol_path <- file.path(
    if (is_mito) p("loci/ftol_mito") else p("loci/ftol_nuclear"),
    paste0(loc_lower, ".fa"))
  ftol_seqs <- read_fasta_list(ftol_path)
  names(ftol_seqs) <- canonicalize(names(ftol_seqs))

  # 3. NCBI
  ncbi_path <- file.path(
    if (is_mito) p("loci/ncbi_mito") else p("loci/ncbi_nuclear"),
    paste0(loc_lower, "_ncbi.fa"))
  ncbi_seqs <- read_fasta_list(ncbi_path)
  names(ncbi_seqs) <- canonicalize(names(ncbi_seqs))

  out_lines <- c()

  for (sp in canonical_taxa) {
    sp_under <- gsub(" ", "_", sp)

    # Mitogenome always wins
    if (sp %in% names(mito_ext_seqs) && nchar(mito_ext_seqs[[sp]]) > 0) {
      out_lines <- c(out_lines,
                     paste0(">", sp_under,
                            " [source=Mitogenome]",
                            " [accession=", mito_ext_acc[[sp]], "]",
                            " [len=", nchar(mito_ext_seqs[[sp]]), "]"),
                     mito_ext_seqs[[sp]])
      next
    }

    # FToL vs NCBI — pick longer, filter NCBI full mitogenomes (>10kb)
    candidates <- list()

    if (sp %in% names(ftol_seqs) && nchar(ftol_seqs[[sp]]) > 0) {
      acc <- if (!is.na(ftol_acc[sp])) ftol_acc[sp] else "FToL"
      candidates[["FToL"]] <- list(seq = ftol_seqs[[sp]], acc = acc,
                                    len = nchar(ftol_seqs[[sp]]))
    }

    if (sp %in% names(ncbi_seqs) && nchar(ncbi_seqs[[sp]]) > 0) {
      raw_len <- nchar(ncbi_seqs[[sp]])
      if (raw_len < 10000) {
        acc <- ncbi_acc$accession[ncbi_acc$species == sp & ncbi_acc$locus == loc]
        acc <- if (length(acc) > 0) acc[1] else "NCBI"
        candidates[["NCBI"]] <- list(seq = ncbi_seqs[[sp]], acc = acc, len = raw_len)
      }
    }

    if (length(candidates) == 0) {
      out_lines <- c(out_lines,
                     paste0(">", sp_under, " [source=MISSING] [accession=NA] [len=0]"),
                     "")
      next
    }

    best_source <- names(which.max(sapply(candidates, `[[`, "len")))
    best        <- candidates[[best_source]]
    out_lines   <- c(out_lines,
                     paste0(">", sp_under,
                            " [source=", best_source, "]",
                            " [accession=", best$acc, "]",
                            " [len=", best$len, "]"),
                     best$seq)
  }

  outfile  <- file.path(subdir, paste0(loc_lower, ".fa"))
  writeLines(out_lines, outfile)
  n_present <- sum(grepl("source=(?!MISSING)", out_lines, perl = TRUE))
  cat(sprintf("%-10s %d/%d taxa\n", loc, n_present, length(canonical_taxa)))
}

cat("\nDone. Merged fastas in loci/merged/\n")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5. BUILD SUPERMATRIX — 30 TAXA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

read_aligned <- function(loc) {
  is_mito   <- loc %in% mito_loci_names
  loc_lower <- tolower(loc)
  aln_file  <- file.path(
    if (is_mito) p("loci/aligned/mito") else p("loci/aligned/nuclear"),
    paste0(loc_lower, "_aligned.fa"))
  if (!file.exists(aln_file)) return(NULL)
  lines <- readLines(aln_file)
  idx   <- which(startsWith(lines, ">"))
  seqs  <- lapply(seq_along(idx), function(i) {
    seq_end <- if (i < length(idx)) idx[i+1] - 1 else length(lines)
    paste(lines[(idx[i]+1):seq_end], collapse = "")
  })
  names(seqs) <- gsub(" \\[.*", "", sub("^>", "", lines[idx]))
  names(seqs) <- gsub("_", " ", names(seqs))
  seqs
}

partition_info <- list()
col_start      <- 1
matrices       <- list()

for (loc in all_loci) {
  seqs <- read_aligned(loc)
  if (is.null(seqs)) next
  aln_len <- nchar(seqs[[1]])
  mat <- t(sapply(canonical_taxa, function(sp) {
    if (sp %in% names(seqs)) strsplit(seqs[[sp]], "")[[1]]
    else rep("?", aln_len)
  }))
  matrices[[loc]]       <- mat
  partition_info[[loc]] <- list(start = col_start,
                                 end   = col_start + aln_len - 1,
                                 type  = if (loc %in% mito_loci_names) "mtDNA" else "nuDNA")
  col_start <- col_start + aln_len
}

# Add morpho partition
n_morpho      <- length(morpho_raw[[1]])
morpho_mat_30 <- t(sapply(canonical_taxa, function(sp) {
  code <- names(morpho_to_canonical)[morpho_to_canonical == sp]
  if (length(code) > 0 && code %in% names(morpho_raw)) morpho_raw[[code]]
  else rep("?", n_morpho)
}))

matrices[["Morphology"]]       <- morpho_mat_30
partition_info[["Morphology"]] <- list(start = col_start,
                                        end   = col_start + n_morpho - 1,
                                        type  = "Morphology")

supermatrix <- do.call(cbind, matrices)
rownames(supermatrix) <- gsub(" ", "_", canonical_taxa)

n_mol   <- partition_info[["Morphology"]]$start - 1
n_total <- ncol(supermatrix)

cat("Supermatrix:", nrow(supermatrix), "taxa x", n_total, "chars\n")

dir.create(p("supermatrix"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# Write molecular nexus for BEAUti
con <- file(p("supermatrix/molecular_30taxa.nex"), "w")
writeLines(c("#NEXUS", "",
             "begin data;",
             paste0("  dimensions ntax=", nrow(supermatrix), " nchar=", n_mol, ";"),
             "  format datatype=dna interleave=no missing=? gap=-;",
             "  matrix"), con)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(supermatrix)))
  writeLines(paste0("  ", rownames(supermatrix)[i], "  ",
                    paste(supermatrix[i, 1:n_mol], collapse = "")), con)
writeLines(c("  ;", "end;", ""), con)
writeLines("begin sets;", con)
for (loc in names(partition_info)) {
  if (loc == "Morphology") next
  pi <- partition_info[[loc]]
  writeLines(paste0("  charset ", loc, " = ", pi$start, "-", pi$end, ";"), con)
}
writeLines("end;", con)
close(con)

# Write morpho nexus for BEAUti
con <- file(p("supermatrix/morpho_30taxa.nex"), "w")
writeLines(c("#NEXUS", "",
             "begin data;",
             paste0("  dimensions ntax=", nrow(supermatrix), " nchar=", n_morpho, ";"),
             '  format datatype=standard symbols="0123" interleave=no missing=? gap=-;',
             "  matrix"), con)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(supermatrix)))
  writeLines(paste0("  ", rownames(supermatrix)[i], "  ",
                    paste(supermatrix[i, (n_mol+1):n_total], collapse = "")), con)
writeLines(c("  ;", "end;"), con)
close(con)

cat("Written: molecular_30taxa.nex and morpho_30taxa.nex\n")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 6. DATA COVERAGE HEATMAP (with real FToL sequence content check)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

check_ftol_content <- function(loc) {
  is_mito   <- loc %in% mito_loci_names
  loc_lower <- tolower(loc)
  path <- file.path(
    if (is_mito) p("loci/ftol_mito") else p("loci/ftol_nuclear"),
    paste0(loc_lower, ".fa"))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  lines <- readLines(path)
  idx   <- which(startsWith(lines, ">"))
  lapply(seq_along(idx), function(i) {
    header  <- sub("^>", "", lines[idx[i]])
    seq_end <- if (i < length(idx)) idx[i+1] - 1 else length(lines)
    seq     <- paste(lines[(idx[i]+1):seq_end], collapse = "")
    raw     <- gsub("[-\\? ]", "", seq)
    data.frame(locus = loc, taxon = canonicalize(header),
               raw_len = nchar(raw), has_data = nchar(raw) >= 100)
  }) |> do.call(what = rbind)
}

ftol_content   <- lapply(all_loci, check_ftol_content) |> do.call(what = rbind)
mito_taxa_sp   <- na.omit(taxonomy$species_full[!is.na(taxonomy$mitogenome_accession)])
morpho_species <- unname(morpho_to_canonical)
target_species <- canonical_taxa

coverage_source_real <- expand.grid(
  species = target_species,
  locus   = c(locus_order, "Morphology"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  left_join(bind_rows(locus_type,
                       data.frame(locus = "Morphology", type = "Morphology")),
            by = "locus") |>
  mutate(
    has_mitogenome = species %in% mito_taxa_sp & locus %in% mito_loci_names,
    has_ftol = mapply(function(sp, loc) {
      if (loc == "Morphology") return(FALSE)
      row <- ftol_content[ftol_content$taxon == sp & ftol_content$locus == loc, ]
      if (nrow(row) == 0) return(FALSE)
      row$has_data[1]
    }, species, locus),
    has_ncbi = mapply(function(sp, loc) {
      if (loc == "Morphology") return(FALSE)
      row <- coverage_ncbi[coverage_ncbi$species == sp & coverage_ncbi$locus == loc, ]
      if (nrow(row) == 0) return(FALSE)
      isTRUE(row$found[1])
    }, species, locus),
    has_morpho = species %in% morpho_species & locus == "Morphology",
    source = case_when(
      locus == "Morphology" & has_morpho ~ "Morphology",
      locus == "Morphology"              ~ "Missing",
      has_mitogenome                     ~ "Mitogenome",
      has_ftol                           ~ "FToL",
      has_ncbi                           ~ "NCBI only",
      TRUE                               ~ "Missing"
    ),
    source = factor(source, levels = c("Mitogenome","FToL","NCBI only",
                                        "Morphology","Missing"))
  )

locus_counts_real <- coverage_source_real |>
  filter(source != "Missing") |>
  count(locus, name = "n_taxa")

coverage_source_real |>
  left_join(locus_counts_real, by = "locus") |>
  mutate(
    locus_label = paste0(locus, "\n(n=", ifelse(is.na(n_taxa), 0, n_taxa), ")"),
    locus_label = factor(locus_label,
                          levels = unique(locus_label[order(match(locus,
                                           c(locus_order, "Morphology")))])),
    species = factor(species, levels = rev(target_species)),
    type    = factor(type, levels = c("mtDNA", "nuDNA", "Morphology"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = locus_label, y = species, fill = source)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Mitogenome" = "#2d6a4f", "FToL"       = "#52b788",
    "NCBI only"  = "#f4a261", "Morphology" = "#9b72cf",
    "Missing"    = "#f0f0f0")) +
  facet_grid(. ~ type, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Data coverage by source", x = "", y = "", fill = "Source") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8),
        strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold"))

# 7. TREE VISUALISATION
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── 7a. Mitogenome IQ-TREE ──────────────────────────────────────────
mito_tree <- read.tree(p("trees/boxfish_mito_iqtree.treefile")) |>
  relabel_tips(acc_to_species) |>
  (\(t) root(t, grep("Triodon", t$tip.label, value = TRUE), resolve.root = TRUE))()

par(mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
plot(mito_tree, main = "Mitogenome IQ-TREE (GTR+G, 1000 BS)",
     cex = 0.8, label.offset = 0.005)
nodelabels(mito_tree$node.label, cex = 0.6, frame = "none",
           adj = c(1.2, -0.3), col = "blue")
add.scale.bar()

# ── 7b. Nuclear IQ-TREE ────────────────────────────────────────────
nuclear_tree <- read.tree(p("ftol/nuclear_iqtree.treefile")) |>
  (\(t) root(t, "Triodon_macropterus", resolve.root = TRUE))()
nuclear_tree$tip.label <- gsub("_", " ", nuclear_tree$tip.label)

# ── 7c. ASTRAL coalescent species tree ─────────────────────────────
astral_tree <- read.tree(p("trees/astral_species_tree_final.tre"))
astral_tree$tip.label <- gsub("_", " ", astral_tree$tip.label)
astral_tree <- root(astral_tree, "Triodon macropterus", resolve.root = TRUE)

ggtree(astral_tree) +
  geom_tiplab(fontface = "italic", size = 3) +
  geom_nodelab(aes(label = ifelse(as.numeric(label) >= 0.7,
                                   round(as.numeric(label), 2), "")),
               size = 2.5, hjust = 1.2, vjust = -0.4) +
  xlim(0, 12) +
  labs(title = "ASTRAL coalescent species tree",
       caption = "Node labels = local posterior probability (>=0.7 shown)")

# ── 7d. BEAST total evidence timetree ──────────────────────────────
beast_tree <- read.beast(p("beast/beast_MCC.tre"))
beast_tree@phylo <- root(beast_tree@phylo, "Triodon_macropterus", resolve.root = TRUE)
beast_tree@phylo$tip.label <- gsub("_", " ", beast_tree@phylo$tip.label)

root_age <- max(node.depth.edgelength(as.phylo(beast_tree)))

ggtree(beast_tree, right = TRUE) +
  geom_tiplab(fontface = "italic", size = 3) +
  geom_nodelab(aes(label = round(posterior, 2)),
               size = 2, hjust = 1.5, vjust = -0.6) +
  theme_tree2() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, root_age, by = 10),
    labels = function(x) round(root_age - x, 0),
    name   = "Million years ago (Ma)",
    limits = c(0, root_age + 30)
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = root_age - c(23, 34, 56),
             linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
  annotate("text", x = root_age - c(23, 34, 56), y = 3,
           label = c("Miocene", "Oligocene", "Eocene"),
           size = 2.5, angle = 90, vjust = -0.3, colour = "grey40") +
  labs(title = "BEAST total evidence timetree (26 taxa, 20M generations)")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 8. BEAST CONVERGENCE CHECK
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

check_ess <- function(log_paths, burnin = 0.25) {
  logs <- lapply(log_paths, function(f) {
    if (!file.exists(f)) { message("Not found: ", f); return(NULL) }
    df <- read.table(f, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", comment.char = "#")
    df[ceiling(nrow(df) * burnin):nrow(df), ]
  })
  logs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), logs)
  ess  <- sapply(logs, function(df) effectiveSize(mcmc(df$posterior)))
  cat("ESS per chain:", paste(round(ess), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Min ESS:", round(min(ess)), "-- target >200\n")
  invisible(ess)
}

# Run 1 (20M generations, 26 taxa)
run1_logs <- p(paste0("beast/run_1_chain_", 1:4, ".log"))
cat("Run 1 ESS:\n"); check_ess(run1_logs)
```
